about: Demos that belong at a time of day rather than in the running order.
See rotation-cues.example.json for what every field means, and the cue
section of ftsched.py for why this is a pin rather than a jump.
dolly is switched off in rotation-betelgeuse.json on purpose. It is a
clock gag -- the panel reads 9:25 with the colon blinking -- and a clock
gag at twenty past three is not a gag, it is a wall telling the wrong
time. So it is reached from here and from nowhere else.
Twice: once for the morning and once for the evening, because the room
has people in it at both and the joke works in both.
